title: Almond Flour Brownies
changes_from_base: Ground almonds replace the wheat flour (gluten-free), with flaked almonds on top.
summary: Rich cocoa brownies made with ground almonds and topped with flaked almonds.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line a deep 20 cm tin.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the melted butter, sugar, salt, vanilla and cocoa together, then beat in the eggs until glossy.

steps.title: Almonds
steps.text: Stir in the ground almonds and baking powder until evenly mixed; the batter will be thick.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread it in the tin, scatter the flaked almonds over and bake 33-38 min, until the top is set and a cocktail stick comes out nearly clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely before cutting into 16; they firm up as they cool.

tips: Use finely ground blanched almonds rather than coarse almond meal with skins, so the brownies bake up fudgy and smooth.
Check the baking powder is labelled gluten-free if you need it.
Use a deep tin; the batter rises a little.
They cut best once fully cool.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
